buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of SAIL SALEM STEEL PLANT payable at SALEM .

Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of SAIL SALEM STEEL PLANT payable at SALEM . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name SAIL, SALEM STEEL PLANT Account No. 10215486898 IFSC Code SBIN0005739 Bank Name State Bank of India, Salem Steel Plant Campus Branch address State Bank of India, Salem Steel Plant Campus, SALEM 636030 . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The specification shall be strictly as per the Salem Steel Plant. 2.The bidder shall offer the price on "F.O.R Salem Steel Plant" basis in GeM portal including P&F charges, F reight & Insurance Charges etc with applicable taxes & duties as per the General Terms and Conditions of GeM. 3. The payment shall be as per clause no.14.0 of Commercial Terms and Conditions. 4. Unless otherwise specified in the tender terms, the inspection will be at Salem Steel Plant after receipt o f the consignment. 5. The bidder shall enclose signed and sealed copy of the technical specification, as a token to acceptance to the tendered item's specification. 6. The bidder shall not quote/attach any price/price bid format along with their technical offer. The offer of such bidder will be summarily rejected. 7. The MII/MSE preferences shall only be given to bidders subject to submission/verification of valid MII cer tificate/Udhayam Certificate. 8. The bidders are required to self-certify the local content in their product for purchase value less than Rs. 10 crore. For purchases more than Rs.10 crore, as per para 9 (b) of PPP-MII Order, 2017, a certificate from the statutory auditor or cost auditor of the company (in the case of companies) or from a practicing cost ac countantor practicing chartered accountant (in respect of suppliers other than companies) is required to b e submitted. Please refer Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC. 9. The applicable EMD amount is Rs.10,00,000/- only (Rupees Twenty Lakhs Only). Refer EMD Clause no.8. 0 of commercial terms and conditions for details. 10. The bidder shall peremptorily enclose duly filled, signed and sealed copy of "Undertaking, Statement of

Deviation, Declaration for acceptance of RFQ specification, Taxes & Duties, MII Certificate, Details of Docu ments wrt Eligibility Criteria and land border sharing clause" under the header “Additional Doc 1 (Requeste d in ATC)” and other documents, as sought in eligibility criteria along with their technical offer. The detaile d specification, proforma for EMD, SDBG, Forms, Commercial Terms and Conditions, Eligibility Criteria and Checklist are uploaded under "Buyer Added Bi d Specific ATC". The bidders shall download the documents uploaded under "Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC" and submit the tender accordingly. The steel scrap form a nd Dimensions and Capacity shall be as per the detailed specification of Salem Steel Plant uploaded under "Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC". 11. The bidder shall submit the required documents sought under the "Eligibility Criteria" for evaluation of their offer. 12. The bidders, submitting Profit/Loss statement issued by practicing Chartered Accountants should have Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN), as mandated by Institute of Chartered Accountants of Indi a (ICAI). 13. Salem Steel Plant has implemented Anti-Bribery Management System (ABMS) as per ISO 3700 1:2016 standard and in order to involve the external agencies, the following undertaking is taken from the Supplie rs /Contractors / Vendors “By participating in this tender, the Suppliers/Vendors/Customers are deemed to have undertaken that they shall not give or take any financial or non-financial bribe, to or from anyone dur ing the tender or during the execution of the contract, thereafter and if they notice any such incident happ ening, they shall report to SAIL Vigilance.” 14. The successful bidder is required to submit security deposit of 3% (Three Percentage) of Total Order va lue (excl taxes & duties) in the form of Demand Draft/Bank Guarantee etc. The SDBG should be valid for th e period till completion of delivery period as per the purchase order with claim period of six months from t he date of expiry. Refer Clause no.18.0 of Commercial Terms and Conditions for details" . 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
